versions.name: Camp Big Timber
versions.summary: A multi-use Three Fires Council camp in Elgin, Illinois, near Randall Road and Interstate 90, with lodge and cabin rentals, tent campsites, program fields, and BB and archery ranges used for weekend unit camping and group events.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council and operating status re-verified from the Three Fires Council camp page. The council describes it as a multi-use rental and short-term camping property rather than the resident summer camp the source hint implied, so it is classified as a short-term camp. Coordinates geocoded via US Census; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council camp page; camp_type/program_types classified conservatively as weekend/short-term camping; features unsurveyed.
